description: Source code for task management in an AUTOSAR OS implementation, including task state transitions, context switching, and scheduling functions.

methods.name: Os_TaskRunningToReady
methods.description: Transitions a task from running to ready state.

methods.name: Os_TaskMakeReady
methods.description: Sets a task to ready state and inserts it into the ready list.

methods.name: Os_TaskMakeWaiting
methods.description: Sets a task to waiting state and removes it from the ready list.

methods.name: Os_TaskMakeSleeping
methods.description: Sets a task to sleeping state and removes it from the ready list.

methods.name: Os_TaskMakeWaitingOnSem
methods.description: Sets a task to waiting semaphore state and removes it from the ready list.

methods.name: Os_TaskMakeSuspended
methods.description: Suspends a task and removes it from the ready list.

methods.name: Os_TaskStartExtended
methods.description: Starts an extended task, setting up resources and context.

methods.name: Os_TaskStartBasic
methods.description: Starts a basic task, setting up resources and context.

methods.name: Os_StackSetup
methods.description: Initializes the stack for a task, setting the bottom and context.

methods.name: Os_StackFill
methods.description: Fills the task stack with a pattern for stack monitoring.

methods.name: Os_TaskContextInit
methods.description: Initializes task context and stack, sets task to ready or suspended.

methods.name: Os_ContextReInit
methods.description: Reinitializes the task context and stack.

methods.name: Os_TaskGetTop
methods.description: Finds the highest priority ready or running task.

methods.name: Os_Dispatch
methods.description: Performs task dispatching based on scheduling operations.

methods.name: Os_TaskSwapContext
methods.description: Swaps context from old to new task.

methods.name: Os_TaskSwapContextTo
methods.description: Swaps context to a specified task.

methods.name: Os_Arc_GetStackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves stack information for a task.

methods.name: Os_Arc_GetTaskName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a task.

methods.name: GetTaskState
methods.description: Returns the current state of a task.

methods.name: GetTaskID
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currently running task.

methods.name: GetISRID
methods.description: Returns the current ISR ID.

methods.name: ActivateTask
methods.description: Activates a task, making it ready to run.

methods.name: TerminateTask
methods.description: Terminates the current task.

methods.name: ChainTask
methods.description: Chains execution to another task.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Performs scheduling to switch to higher priority task if available.
